name: kb_search
description: Search an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base for relevant documents using hybrid vector and keyword search. Returns formatted results with citations from ingested PDFs and documents.

query.description: The search query to find relevant documents in the knowledge base

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (optional, default = 5)

user_id.description: User ID to scope results. Returns user's own docs + shared base docs. (optional)
